notes: Proposal artifact only; does not mutate the locked source artifact.

field_semantics.caveat_type: Machine-readable caveat category; human caveat text is carried separately in caveat_text/customer_facing_caveat.
field_semantics.caveat_text: Human-readable caveat that may be surfaced only when customer_surface_policy is show_with_caveat.
field_semantics.last_verified_date: YYYY-MM-DD date when official source support was last verified.
field_semantics.next_reverification_due: YYYY-MM-DD date when reviewer should re-check the source before continued promotion.
field_semantics.stale_after_date: YYYY-MM-DD date after which the row/field must fail closed until reverified.
field_semantics.source_retrieval_method: Controlled vocabulary describing how the source snapshot was obtained.
field_semantics.source_snapshot_ref: Stable local/internal reference to the reviewed source snapshot or locked artifact row.
field_semantics.customer_surface_policy: Controls whether a field may be shown as fact, shown with caveat, suppressed but logged internally, or never shown.
